integrity: The polynomial certificate and eliminated jerk identity were reconstructed from the vector field and replayed by an included dependency-free exact sparse-polynomial checker. The moment, positivity, rigidity, support-crossing, and Wirtinger arguments are analytic. Same-object literature was inspected at full-text, full-chapter, or indexed-statement level as documented; one highly relevant synchronization paper remained inaccessible at full-text level. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns compactly supported invariant probability measures, bounded complete trajectories, and periodic orbits of the positive-parameter generalized Sprott L family. It does not prove existence of non-equilibrium recurrence for every parameter triple, stability, entropy, mixing, basin properties, or attainability of the strict period infimum.
title: Stationary derivative-energy law and strict period floor in the generalized Sprott L flow
